records.title: Fat Brands Clears Hurdle To Pitch Post-Sale Ch. 11 Plan
records.summary: A Texas bankruptcy judge granted conditional approval for the disclosure statement of Fat Brands' Chapter 11 plan, allowing the chain restaurant operator to seek creditor votes on its post-sale liquidation plan.

records.title: Suspended Fla. Lawyer's Bankruptcy Case Thrown Out
records.summary: A Florida bankruptcy court judge has dismissed the Chapter 13 case of a suspended lawyer facing state bar disciplinary charges over allegations that he defrauded dozens of clients by charging them legal fees for cases that he abandoned.

records.title: Lugano OK To Hand Over Insurance For Lost $10.5M Diamond
records.summary: Jewelry house Lugano Diamonds on Monday secured a Delaware bankruptcy judge's tentative approval to transfer an insurance policy to a creditor that consigned the debtor a diamond worth $10.5 million that later went missing.

records.title: Justices Won't Hear Challenge To 'Texas Two-Step' Ch. 11
records.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court on Monday said it won't hear a challenge by asbestos claimants to the "Texas two-step" bankruptcy of Georgia-Pacific spinoff Bestwall.

records.title: NY Judge Doubts Nussbaum-Linked Firms Belong In Ch. 11
records.summary: A New York bankruptcy judge on Friday questioned whether his court was the proper venue to wind down two commercial real estate law firms headed by Mark J. Nussbaum as the debtors sought to ditch an assignment for the benefit of creditors process in New York state court.
